title.zh-TW: 透過連結加入，好友可得運費折抵券 2 張
title.en: Join through the link and get 2 shipping-fee coupons

text.zh-TW: App 消費滿 NT$500 折 NT$100（7 天）、滿 NT$1,000 折 NT$100（30 天）。取自平台分享文案與邀請頁；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: NT$100 off at NT$500+ App spend (7 days), NT$100 off at NT$1,000+ (30 days). From the share text and invite page; official terms prevail.

title.zh-TW: 邀請人可得 7% OFF 優惠券
title.en: The referrer gets a 7% OFF coupon

text.zh-TW: 好友完成首購後發放；App 消費滿 NT$1,000，最高折抵 NT$100，有效期限 30 天。取自平台分享文案；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: After a friend's first purchase: NT$1,000+ App spend, up to NT$100 off, 30 days. From the platform's share text; actual terms follow the official announcements.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結（沒有邀請碼，邀請人資訊已在連結中）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the invite link (there is no code; the referrer's details are already in the link).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示註冊 Pinkoi 帳號，註冊後運費折抵券會自動入帳，不需要輸入代碼；已有帳號者是否適用，以官方公告為準。
steps.en: Register a Pinkoi account as the page directs; the shipping-fee coupons are credited after registering (no code). Existing members: see official announcements.

steps.zh-TW: 在 Pinkoi App 內消費時使用這 2 張運費折抵券：滿 NT$500 折 NT$100（有效期限 7 天）、滿 NT$1,000 折 NT$100（有效期限 30 天）。
steps.en: Use the two shipping-fee coupons on App purchases: NT$100 off at NT$500 or more (valid 7 days) and NT$100 off at NT$1,000 or more (valid 30 days).

intro.zh-TW: 透過邀請連結加入 Pinkoi，可得運費折抵券 2 張：App 消費滿 NT$500 或 NT$1,000，各折 NT$100。
intro.en: Join Pinkoi through this link and get 2 shipping-fee coupons: NT$100 off at NT$500 or NT$1,000 App spend.

description.zh-TW:
Pinkoi 是以設計商品為主的線上購物平台，提供網站與 App。這是邀請人專屬的邀請連結，邀請人的名稱已包含在連結網址中，沒有另外的邀請碼，請直接透過本頁連結註冊。

依 Pinkoi 邀請頁與分享文案，透過連結加入的好友可獲得運費折抵券 2 張：App 消費滿 NT$500 折 NT$100（有效期限 7 天），以及 App 消費滿 NT$1,000 折 NT$100（有效期限 30 天）。邀請人則會在好友完成首購後獲得 7% OFF 優惠券。實際內容、金額與期限以 Pinkoi 官方公告為準。
description.en:
Pinkoi is an online marketplace focused on design goods, available on the web and as a mobile App. This is the referrer's personal invite link: the referrer's name is part of the link address and there is no separate code to type, so sign up through the link on this page.

According to Pinkoi's invite page and the share text, a friend who joins through the link gets two shipping-fee coupons: NT$100 off with App spend of NT$500 or more (valid for 7 days), and NT$100 off with App spend of NT$1,000 or more (valid for 30 days). The referrer receives a 7% OFF coupon after the friend completes a first purchase. Actual terms, amounts and deadlines follow Pinkoi's official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 這是邀請人專屬連結（網址內含邀請人名稱），沒有可手動輸入的邀請碼，請直接透過連結註冊。依分享文案，優惠券的使用門檻都以 Pinkoi App 內的消費金額計算，金額為新台幣。邀請人的 7% OFF 優惠券在好友完成首購後發放；好友的運費折抵券，依 Pinkoi 官方邀請頁說明在註冊後入帳。優惠內容取自平台分享文案，Pinkoi 可能隨時調整或終止活動，實際條件與期限以官方公告為準；已有帳號者是否適用，也以官方公告為準。
notes.en: This is the referrer's personal invite link (the referrer's name is part of the address) with no invite code to type in, so sign up through the link itself. Per the share text, the coupon conditions are all written as Pinkoi App spend, and amounts are in NT$. The referrer's 7% OFF coupon is issued after a friend's first purchase, while Pinkoi's invite page says the friend's shipping-fee coupons are received after registering. The offer comes from the platform's share text; Pinkoi may change or end it at any time, so actual terms and deadlines follow the official announcements, and so does whether existing members qualify.

q.zh-TW: Pinkoi 邀請連結的優惠，誰會拿到？
q.en: Who gets the rewards from a Pinkoi invite link?

a.zh-TW: 透過連結加入的好友可獲得運費折抵券 2 張：App 消費滿 NT$500 折 NT$100（有效期限 7 天）、App 消費滿 NT$1,000 折 NT$100（有效期限 30 天）。邀請人則在好友完成首購後獲得 7% OFF 優惠券（App 消費滿 NT$1,000，最高折抵 NT$100，有效期限 30 天）。實際內容以 Pinkoi 官方公告為準。
a.en: A friend who joins through the link gets two shipping-fee coupons: NT$100 off with App spend of NT$500 or more (valid 7 days) and NT$100 off with App spend of NT$1,000 or more (valid 30 days). The referrer gets a 7% OFF coupon after the friend's first purchase (App spend of NT$1,000 or more, up to NT$100 off, valid 30 days). Actual terms follow Pinkoi's official announcements.

q.zh-TW: Pinkoi 邀請連結需要輸入邀請碼嗎？
q.en: Do I need to enter an invite code for a Pinkoi invite link?

a.zh-TW: 不需要。這條連結沒有另外的邀請碼，邀請人資訊已包含在連結網址中，直接透過本頁的連結註冊即可。
a.en: No. This link has no separate invite code; the referrer's details are already part of the link address, so just sign up through the link on this page.
